programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: Travis Block, a shadowy government agent who specializes in removing operatives whose covers have been exposed, uncovers a deadly conspiracy within his own ranks that reaches the highest echelons of power.

programme.title: X-Game
programme.desc: Based loosely on a horror novel, four kidnapped university students become entangled in a revenge story born out of past bullying. Hideaki took part in a bullying game in his elementary school called 'X Game' where unsuspecting victims picked their fates from a lottery list of pranks. Imprisoned together with three other classmates from the elementary school, they are made to play a new type of ' X Game .' This time around, however, the bullying is much, much worse.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. After a failed suicide attempt, the traumatized young woman awakes from a coma with total memory loss, only to be greeted by her husband, Nick, whom she has no recollection of. She tries to piece together the events that led to her attempted suicide and to get accustomed to her new life, but reality grows murkier everyday until she is unsure what is real and what is not.

programme.title: Kawan Aku Mati Dalam Rumah Sewa
programme.desc: Rudy is a film extra who is always playing ghost characters. Akhiruddin is a petrol station attendant. Remy shines shoes along the five-foot ways around the city. The three of them rent a house from Pak Cik Osman but they are three months behind in rent. One day, Pak Cik Osman's nephew Saipol, an illegal motor racer, comes to put with them for a while. That night, Saipol wins a race and goes home with RM10,000 in cash on him. Rudy so happens to get home at the same time, still in his vampire costume. Saipol is so frightened that he has a heart attack and dies on the spot. Akhiruddin and Remy follow behind and the three bachelors start panicking over what to do with Saipol's corpse. Will Saipol come back to haunt them and get back the money?

programme.title: Hospital
programme.desc: Amira, a village girl, comes to the city to interview for the position of nurse in a hospital. While trying to find the hospital, she meets Dahlia who works there. Amira is accepted for the position and Dahlia invites her to be her housemate. Ever since then, Amira is haunted by spooky encounters and even starts to see ominous shadows. Her acquaintance with a young doctor, Farid, adds to all the chaos that Amira is going through. Because of the stress, Amira loses her grip on reality and can no longer tell whether she is dreaming or not.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.

programme.title: Cucuk Sanggul Seroja
programme.desc: Suri terjumpa cucuk sanggul lama yang dihantui oleh roh Seroja, wanita yang mati membunuh diri kerana cintanya dihalang.

programme.title: The House of Snails
programme.desc: Writer Antonio Prieto decides to spend the summer in the mountains outside Malaga, where he hopes to find peace and quiet as well as inspiration for his next novel. Once there, he meets Berta, a woman he feels instantly attracted to. However, Antonio soon finds out that the locals are hiding numerous secrets, as well as a dark and terrifying legend. His experiences there will lead him to discover that, sometimes, reality is much stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Malam Tahlil Suhaila Balik
programme.desc: In bearing the pain of Suhaila's death, her husband faces an unexpectedly problem when she returns home at one of his 'tahlil' nights.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
programme.desc: The Horror Hound festival holds its first ever event in Louisiana, attracting hundreds of geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans from far and wide. Fanboy Chase forces his girlfriend Laine to come along for the ride. As the event begins, Laine starts to experience unexplained premonitions and disturbing visions. As the blood-soaked entertainment builds to a frenzy, Laine believes that something unearthly has been summoned and that she is at the center of it.

programme.title: Waris Jari Hantu

programme.title: Nafsu Mental
